name: Shinohara Yoshie
source:
Hobbies: Shopping on holidays
Likes: [url=https://takashionary.com/goukon/]Goukon[/url] (Japanese-style group blind dates)
Dislikes: Men (not good at dealing with them)

A nurse at Chisakura General Hospital who acts like [url=/c54964]Annabella[/url]'s assistant. She is bright and energetic, but sometimes goes too far with her good mood and makes silly mistakes.

She is one of the few people who know about Annabella's research.
